description: Start a one-hour domain challenge bound to your private random 32-byte requester key in lowercase hex. Publish the returned JSON exactly at its HTTPS well-known URL. Keep the requester key private. An imported directory listing or completed scan is required before confirmation. No payment or target credentials are sent. Optionally supply contact_email and email_consent true for transactional verification/recovery/outcome messages. Contact stays private and must be verified by a mailed code after domain confirmation. No message is sent before successful domain proof. Never signs payments.
name: start_ownership_proof
